svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Despegar — Software Developer, Feb 2026 to present: Frontend development and maintenance for Cross Selling, focused on user experience and conversion. Reusable component design and API integration, with close attention to performance and code quality. Collaboration with Product, Design and Backend teams, applying code reviews and shared engineering standards. Almundo — Software Developer, Jun 2025 to Feb 2026: Cars and Tours verticals, built with Angular 17/18 and Java / Spring Boot 3. White-label microsites for partners: parameterization, SEO and performance. BackOffice platform: feature flags, permissions, reporting and support tooling. Cars supplier integration (CNET) with retries, validation and resilience handling. Hexagonal architecture and idempotent pipelines over MongoDB, Cassandra and OpenSearch. NTT Data — Software Developer, Sep 2022 to Jun 2025: Design of scalable distributed systems with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. RESTful APIs using WebFlux, with Circuit Breaker and Retry patterns via Resilience4j. PostgreSQL and Oracle optimization: indexing, query tuning and Hibernate tuning. Asynchronous processing with RabbitMQ and ActiveMQ. CI/CD with GitLab and Jenkins, deploying to OpenShift. Freelance — Full Stack Developer, Jan 2021 to present: Modern, responsive landing pages built with React and Next.js. RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express. Custom administrative dashboards and SEO optimization. Web development for Cubiqa Studio, delivering premium real-estate project sites.
